newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-FRENCH DEFENDER MAHE JOINS CELTIC.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-FRENCH DEFENDER MAHE JOINS CELTIC.

text.p: Scottish premier division side Celtic signed defender Stephane Mahe from French club Rennes for 650,000 pounds ($1.1 million) on Wednesday.

The 28-year-old left back, who signed a three-year contract, is the fourth acquisition by new Dutch coach Wim Jansen following the arrival of Scotland internationals Craig Burley and Darren Jackson and Swede Henrik Larsson.
Mahe formerly played for Auxerre and Paris St Germain, gaining a solitary French cap.
"I have played for top clubs in France but the appeal and stature of Celtic is the exciting move I have been aiming for," he said. ($ = 0.613 British Pounds)
